description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure fault injection and transactional state storage in Orleans, specifically for controlled fault injection scenarios in testing environments.

classes.name: TransactionFaultInjectionServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to set up fault injection transactional state and storage.

methods.name: UseControlledFaultInjectionTransactionState
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use a controlled fault injection transactional state for testing.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Adds Azure Table transactional state storage with fault injection capabilities to the service collection.
